name: ballerinax/aws
description: This module provides AWS authentication functionalities including credential resolution and AWS Signature Version 4 request signing.

typeDefs.name: ErrorDetails
typeDefs.description:
The shared error details record connectors. The fields are populated when the
failure originates from an AWS service call, and are left unset when the failure
occurs before a response is received (e.g. an invalid configuration).

fields.name: httpStatusCode
fields.description: The HTTP status code for the error

fields.name: httpStatusText
fields.description: The HTTP status text returned from the service

fields.name: errorCode
fields.description: The error code associated with the response

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.description: The human-readable error message provided by the service

fields.name: requestId
fields.description: The unique identifier for the request, as assigned by AWS

fields.name: customEndpoint
fields.description:
Full endpoint URL override (e.g. `http://localhost:4566`). When set,
all other options are ignored and the value is returned as given

functions.name: resolveEndpoint
resolveEndpointHost

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Endpoint options; a `customEndpoint` is returned with its scheme stripped
